content: 'Ekipitu 'ixaheritsixi kememɨte'uta'aitɨarie
'Ikɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni 'Ixaheri niwemama, kepauka yuniwema mewaruwitɨtɨ memu'axɨa 'Ekipitu, Kakuwu yunaitɨ:
Xuweni, Tsimehuni, Rewi, Kura,
'Itsakaxi, Tsawuruni, Wenikamini,
Rani, Nepɨtahari, Kahari meta 'Atsexi.
Yunaitɨ Kakuwu nuiwarimama mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai, haika tewiyari heimana tamamata. 'Ekipitu paitɨri Kutse pukatei.
Hikɨ Kutse meta 'iwamama mekaniukwini meta mɨkɨ xiɨyarimama yunaitɨ.
Peru matsi 'ixaheritsixi, waɨkawa tɨɨri mekaniwarayexeiyakaitɨni, yumɨiretɨ mekanakɨne metɨrɨkaɨyetɨ, mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie mekanakɨnɨximekaitɨni. Kiekari 'ayeutɨ kanayeiximekaitɨni.
Hikɨ 'Ekipitu xewitɨ pɨta ti'aitame kananukakeni Kutse mɨkahetimaikai kemɨtiuyuri,
mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe yuteɨterima: «Xekeneyukweriwayurieka 'ixaheritsixi wahepaɨtsita, waɨkawa tɨrɨkariya mekanexeiyani, mekaniyɨmɨireniri mekatana'iwani.

Hikɨ tekateniwata'aitɨakuni waɨkawamekɨ tetemaiwawetɨ, xɨka mɨpaɨ tekate'uyurieni matsi waɨkawa mepɨtamɨire, xɨka kuyaxa hayani, memɨtatsi'aye'unieta pɨta mekanakɨnikuni, metatsi'a'iwame mekaniyehuni 'ikɨ kwieyaritsie».

Mɨpaɨ mekateniuyurieni 'ekipitutari, te'aitamete mekaniwarutihɨawe 'ixaheritsixi memɨtewata'aitɨanikɨ, 'uximayatsika mekaniwaruxatɨani waɨriyarika mewapitɨatɨ, Parahuni hetsiemieme kiekari 'ikwai mɨreuta'ɨnarɨwa Pituni mɨtitewa meta Xamɨtsexi.
Peru matsi mɨyamewaruyurieku, matsi waɨkawa mekanixiɨkaitɨni mepɨtamɨirirɨmekai, hikɨ 'ekipitutsixi waɨkawa mekaniwarutimakani.
'Ayumieme kwinimieme mekateniwa'uximayatsitɨakaitɨni, kemɨkareuyewetse hepaɨ mekateniwa'aitɨakaitɨni.

Watukari waɨkawa mekaninanaimakaitɨni, waɨriyarika metewa'aitɨatɨ, kwie memɨhawiyanikɨ, xɨnariya wewiyarikɨ, naime mɨrati'etsiwatsie, tita 'uximayatsika mɨraniere, naime 'uximayatsikatsie 'ixaheritsixi memɨteha'uximayakai 'ekipitutari mewarutate'atɨ mekateniwa'aitɨakaitɨni.
Mana mekanititekaitɨni yuhutatɨ 'ukarawetsixi hepɨrayutsixi teɨteriyari teniweritsitɨwamete, Tsipura meta Puwa metetetewatɨ, ti'aitame 'Ekipitu kiekame mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'aitɨani:
—Kepauka 'ukarawetsixi hepɨrayutsixi xemɨwaparewie niweriyakɨ, xeyu'ɨwiyatɨ tita mɨtitinuiwa: xɨka 'ukitɨni xewatakukuyatɨ, xɨka 'ukatɨni xekenehayewa 'ayeniereme.
Peru 'ukarawetsixi teniweritsitɨwamete hepɨrayutsixi Kakaɨyari mekanayemakakaitɨni, 'ayumieme ti'aitame 'Ekipitu kiekame kemɨtiwarahɨawekai yamepɨkate'uyuri, 'ukitsi mekaniwaruhayewa me'ayeneniereme.
Hikɨ 'Ekipitu kwieyaritsie ti'aitame, mɨkɨ 'ukarawetsixi teniweritsitɨwamete kaniwarutakwewieni, mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'iwawiya: —¿Titayari mɨya xeteheyurie? ¿Titayari tɨɨri 'ukitsi xekatewatakukuya?
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —Neuxeitsɨ, 'ukari hepɨrayutsixi 'ukarawetsixi 'ekipitutari wahepaɨ mepɨka'anene, mɨkɨ waɨkawa mepɨtɨrɨkawi yuxaɨta mepɨtiniweya tame teka'aye'axɨaximekaku.
Mɨpaɨ tiuyɨku, matsi 'ixaheritsixi waɨkawa mekaniyutamɨiriya. Meta Kakaɨyari mɨkɨ teniweritsitɨwamete 'aixɨa katiniwaruxeiya,
Kakaɨyari memayemakakaikɨ, kaniwarupitɨani tɨɨri waɨkawa memɨwarayexeiyakɨ.
Hikɨ Parahuni mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'aitɨani yuteɨterima: —Yunaime tɨɨri 'ukitsi hepɨrayutsixi hapa xekeniwareukaxɨri memɨtinunuiwa. 'Ukari xekeniwarehayewa.
